question: Chembeti Sridharalu Naidu was a social reformer and was associated with which of the following organisations?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Veda Samaj__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chembeti Sridharalu Naidu was a prominent social reformer in India who made significant contributions to the social and educational landscape.
 
• He was associated with the Veda Samaj, which was an organization committed to the reform of Hindu society with a strong emphasis on the Vedas as a source of rational and ethical guidance.
 
• The Veda Samaj, like other socio-religious movements of the 19th century, aimed at eradicating social evils, promoting women's education, and opposing caste discrimination.
 
• Naidu's work with the Veda Samaj highlights the broader movement of social reform during the British Raj, where intellectuals sought to reinterpret religious texts and practices to align with modern values.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Arya Samaj
 Founded by Swami Dayananda Saraswati, focused on purifying Hinduism and returning to the teachings of the Vedas.
 
 

 Brahmo Samaj
 Founded by Raja Ram Mohan Roy, aimed at reforming societal practices based on rationalism and monotheism.
 
 

 Paramahansa Mandali
 One of the earliest socio-religious reform groups in Maharashtra, aimed at breaking down caste barriers and promoting monotheism.
